definitions.explanation: Being elected again to the same position. Used as a suru-verb, often in the passive form ({再選|さいせん}される).

examples.japanese: ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再選|さいせん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再選|さいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧{選挙活動|せんきょかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: He started campaigning with the aim of re-election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{圧倒的|あっとうてき}→圧倒的：05853_attouteki⟧な⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧、{三期連続|さんきれんぞく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{再選|さいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: With overwhelming support, they achieved re-election for a third consecutive term.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again) + ⟦{選|せん}→選：09879_sen⟧ (election/selection). A standard political term frequently seen in news about elections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再選|さいせん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be re-elected
- {再選|さいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim for re-election
- {再選|さいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to achieve re-election
- {再選|さいせん}⟦{出馬|しゅつば}→出馬：14954_shutsuba⟧: running for re-election

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧: winning an election — used for both first-time and subsequent wins
- ⟦{落選|らくせん}→落選：07075_rakusen⟧: losing an election — the opposite outcome
- ⟦{再任|さいにん}→再任：17443_sainin⟧: reappointment — for appointed rather than elected positions
